text: Malaysia's Home Ministry banned Jacob's Room To Choose by Sarah Hoffman and Ian Hoffman under a prohibition order dated 20 January 2023. The order was issued under Section 7(1) of the Printing Presses and Publications Act 1984 (Amended 2012) and covered three publications: The Tale of Steven, Jacob's Room To Choose and Aku. The ministry said the three were harmful to Malaysian morals and that two contained LGBT elements.
